The '''dart''' was a type of small, stealthy [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was used by the [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Rangers]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In about [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], the [[Far Ranger|vessel]] of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] and his companions [[Den Dhur]] and [[I-5YQ]] was destroyed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and the trio were rescued from a [[Escape pod/Legends|lifepod]] by a group of Rangers that were flying in darts. The darts then transported Pavan and his associates to the resistance base [[Mountain Home]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]].
